You need to stay invested.

This changes the game.

Nasdaq moving toward 23-hour trading, 5 days a week will change market dynamics significantly.

Especially for options and leveraged trading.

More hours = more opportunities for volatility, liquidations and overnight moves.

I wouldn’t be surprised if we start seeing crypto-like price action in equities as markets move closer to 24/7.

The bull market is the easy mode.
